user.title: Emby server
user.description: Address and API key of the Emby server (Emby dashboard -> Advanced -> API keys). When configuration.yaml still has `platform: emby`, the fields are filled in from it.

data_description.host: IP address or name of the Emby server, e.g. 192.168.1.2

error.invalid_auth: The server rejected the API key.

abort.already_configured: This Emby server is already configured.
abort.wrong_server: This address belongs to a different Emby server.

cannot_connect.message: Emby server at {url} is not reachable ({error}); retrying in the background.

command_failed.message: Emby did not accept the command {command}: {error}

yaml_emby_platform.title: Remove the Emby YAML configuration
yaml_emby_platform.description: Emby Plus has replaced the built-in Emby integration, but configuration.yaml still has `media_player: - platform: emby`. While it is there, both integrations show the same players. Remove that block and restart Home Assistant; Emby Plus then takes over the existing `media_player.emby_*` entities with their names, areas and entity IDs.
